Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: original sample food cutout for a polished 9:16 cafe product-release animation, composited floating over cream and black diagonal panels.
Style/medium: photorealistic warm editorial food photography, appetizing and natural, crisp believable material detail.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent PNG alpha background. Empty transparent surroundings, no solid backdrop and no baked checkerboard.
Lighting/mood: soft warm key from upper left, gentle fill, subtle close diffuse grounding shadow contained within transparency; controlled highlights useful on light and dark backgrounds.
Constraints: one complete object, all edges fully visible and uncropped, generous transparent margin. No text, no logo, no watermark, no tabletop, no props, no cutlery, no extra dishes or glasses. This is a sample visual, no business identity.
Subject: creamy penne Alfredo pasta with sliced mushrooms and a restrained scattering of fresh green herbs, in a round shallow matte black ceramic bowl.
Composition/framing: approximately square 1024px image. Centered single bowl, oblique elevated three-quarter food photograph viewed around 45 degrees down from horizontal; whole round rim visible, serving fills bowl naturally. Fine ridges of penne, velvety cream sauce, earthy mushroom slices.
